Earth

Terrestrial Planet
🎓 ASTRONOMY LEARNING (CLASS 5–10)
🙋‍♂️ Meet this object: Earth is the vibrant blue home world where humanity and all known living things live!
❓ What is it? Earth is the third planet from the Sun and a rocky terrestrial world.
📏 How big is it? 12,742 km wide — about 4 times wider than the Moon!
📍 Where is it? 1 AU (149.6 million km) from the Sun in the Solar System.
🧱 What is it made of? A solid iron-nickel core, silicate rock mantle, and a thin crust covered in oceans.
🌡️ What is it like? Temperate with warm oceans, lush continents, and breathable air.
💧 Does it have water? Abundant liquid surface oceans covering 71% of the globe!
💨 Does it have an atmosphere? 78% Nitrogen, 21% Oxygen with an ozone layer shielding radiation.
🌱 Could life exist there? CONFIRMED — Billions of species thrive here!
✨ What makes it special? It is the only world currently confirmed to harbor life in the universe.
💡 Did you know? Earth travels around the Sun at 107,000 km/h (67,000 mph)!
